_note: EDIT ME. Landmarks and arms follow Tabel 3 (goniometer alignment), sagittal view of the tested side. Target angles come from ChenData/StrengthCurve/plot_proposal.m. An angle is the angle between two 'arms'. An arm is [dotA, dotB] (vector from A to B), {"perp": [dotA, dotB]} (perpendicular to A-B, pointing towards the feet), or "up" / "down" / "forward". The hip's pelvis arm runs from the iliac crest dot (halfway between ASIS and PSIS, on the side of the pelvis) down to the greater trochanter: the goniometer's lateral midline of the pelvis. Shown value = sign * angle + offset. 'signed' angles can be negative (extension, posterior tilt); their sign assumes the participant faces RIGHT, and the app mirrors automatically when you choose 'faces left'.

dot_labels.asis: ASIS on the tested side (bony point at the front of the hip bone)
dot_labels.iliac_crest: iliac crest (side of pelvis, halfway between ASIS and PSIS)
dot_labels.strap: strap marker (on the person, where the strap attaches)
dot_labels.anchor: anchor marker (fixed end of the strap, rope or chain)

_optional_dots_note: Extra dots that are tracked and recorded but not part of any angle. They start switched off; tick them in Landmarks to use them. Per test you can override with "optional_dots".
_derived_points_note: Computed points are never clicked: they are calculated from marked dots in every picture and can be used as the end of an arm. 'hip_centre_frontal' estimates the hip joint centre of the tested side in a picture taken from the front, from the two ASIS and the ruler scale (Harrington et al. 2007, equation set 1; see limbtrack/geometry.py for the equation and its status).
_frontal_angles_note: Frontal view (camera in front of the participant). The four frontal angles in angle_library are unsigned interior angles between the arm towards the other ASIS and the thigh; 90 deg = the thigh square to the line between the ASIS = neutral, so the shown value is angle - 90 for abduction (the knee moves away from the other leg) and 90 - angle for adduction. Independent of which leg and of mirroring. 'goniometer' = Tabel 3 as written (fulcrum the ASIS, thigh towards the patella centre); 'hip_centre' = the same thigh line drawn from the estimated hip joint centre, which is what rotates when the leg moves; it is shown and saved but never judged green/red ('judged': false). The two do not share a zero.

tests._note_tests: Tests from Tabel 2 of the protocol draft 2026-09-28 (19 positions in all). The sagittal ones use a side view; the 4 hip abduction/adduction positions (0 and 20 deg, 'view': 'frontal') use a camera in front of the participant (0.15.0); there the sagittal posture (hip flexion 0, straight knee) is controlled by standing against a wall and is not measured. 'targets' are the positions of the measured joint. 'neighbour_targets' are the required angles of the neighbouring joint (H 90, K 0, K 90 in Tabel 2); they are judged from the start, not only after Lock. Extension and plantarflexion are negative in the protocol's table, here they are positions of the joint (hip flexion angle, ankle angle with plantarflexion negative).

hip_abduction.label: Hip abduction, knee straight, camera in front (MVIC)

hip_adduction.label: Hip adduction, knee straight, camera in front (MVIC)
